title: Actually Multiplications
description: Actually Multiplications is a compact addon for Actually mods designed to bridge the gap by adding the armor sets and tools that were "missing" from the original material tiers
body:
Ever felt like **Actually Additions** was missing that final, protective touch? **Actually Multiplications** is a compact addon designed to bridge the gap by adding the armor sets and tools that were "missing" from the original material tiers.

Whether you are looking to suit up in Restonia or swing a Void Crystal axe, this mod ensures your resource progression feels complete and rewarding.

## Key Features
- Adds complete sets of armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots) for all Actually Additions crystal tiers.
- Adds missing tools like Axes, Hoes, and Shovels for materials that previously only supported basic items.
- All items are balanced to fit perfectly alongside existing Actually Additions content, maintaining the intended power progression.
- Completing a full set grants tier-themed status effects while you wear all four pieces. Every tier can be enabled or disabled, and you can customize which effect is applied and its amplifier in your instance config.

## Expanded Equipment
For every crystal tier, this mod adds the full variety of gear to ensure you are never left without the right tool for the job. Each material now supports:

### The Essentials:
- Sword
- Pickaxe
- Axe
- Shovel
- Hoe

### The Ultimate Tool:

- AIOT (All-In-One-Tool): Combining the power of all tools into one versatile instrument.

### Full Armor Sets:
- Helmet
- Chestplate
- Leggings
- Boots

### Crystal Tiers Included

You can now craft gear using:
- Restonia
- Palis
- Diamatine
- Void
- Emeradic
- Enori
- Black Quartz

![Stuff added](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad53424cbf7e84f6f7eecdb2fc71cc2bbec63d24.png)

## Other additions

### Quartz

![Etheric Quartz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f275360e4ab94adc773eb6c90549fce1c382e80.png)

A new set of colored Ethetic Quartz !


---

Note: This mod is an addon and requires either **Actually Additions**. Please ensure you have the correct base mod installed for your Minecraft version !
